pt-BR.title: Ex-vereador Milton Leite se entrega após operação contra PCC
pt-BR.summary: Político compareceu à polícia em Mogi das Cruzes acompanhado de advogado.
paragraphs: O ex-vereador e ex-presidente da Câmara de São Paulo Milton Leite se entregou à polícia em Mogi das Cruzes nesta sexta-feira (18), acompanhado de advogado.
Ele era alvo de prisão temporária em operação da Polícia Civil e do Ministério Público que investiga a atuação do PCC no transporte coletivo paulistano; Leite declarou-se inocente.

en.title: Former councilman Milton Leite turns himself in after PCC operation
en.summary: The politician went to police in Mogi das Cruzes accompanied by a lawyer.
paragraphs: Milton Leite, a former councilman and former president of São Paulo's city council, turned himself in to police in Mogi das Cruzes on Friday, September 18, accompanied by a lawyer.

He was the subject of a temporary arrest order in a Civil Police and São Paulo Prosecutor's Office operation investigating the PCC's activity in the city's public transport; Leite said he was innocent.
